note: Client verdict on the baseline: NOT VERY PLAYABLE. Structural, so the fix is structural. Two changes followed. (1) A tenth law, L10 THE CORE LOOP: a detector firing now opens a timed OUTBREAK, drawn where it happened and named in plain words, which the player must answer with the right institution before the fuse runs out. No piece can be marked won while L10 scores below 8. (2) The client supplied the real source paper, which the egress proxy had blocked. Its four sections ARE the table's four families, the 117 target turns out to be a direct citation, and it hands us the decision the game was missing: institutions TRADE OFF rather than upgrade. LEDGER catches the liar and teaches the colony to ignore the lone dissenter; LENS reveals everything including the rumour. Sub-agent concurrency is capped at 2 on this box, so the seven pieces are consolidated into five.

pieces.name: PLAY — the outbreak loop and the hands that drive it
pieces.judged: L10 the core loop above all: a decision every few seconds, a knowable right answer, immediate located consequence, real answerable time pressure, mastery that accumulates. Then L4 tiny interaction surface and L8 one clear next action, 44px thumb targets.

pieces.name: TEACH — the ten-chapter sequence
pieces.judged: L1 one new idea at a time, L2 play first name second, L6 run it again and see (the chapter 4 A/B), L8 no dead time, L9 the sandbox is the reward

pieces.name: READ — field and table legibility
pieces.judged: L3 the causal beat visible, immediate and co-located; L7 readable at 390px; can a stranger read the field in three seconds; does a lit cell point at bodies on the field

pieces.name: WORLD — 28 detectors, trade-offs, balance
pieces.judged: audit.js all 28 fire with working counters; CONTRACT section 15 trade-offs actually implemented and felt; conflicts resolve into force/passivity/truce/unsettled; speed raises throughput AND aggression; ch9 losable but winnable

pieces.name: SHELL — visual system and voice
pieces.judged: L5 plainspoken warm funny voice, palette and typographic discipline, no layout break 320-430px, the real research facts landing as content rather than footnotes
